answer: Picture the economy as a terraced meadow where value only grows where independent peers vouch for your work. Tie emission rewards strictly to attestations from non-kin graders, never from accounts you yourself invited. A sybil ring can wander endlessly among its own clones, but with no outside edges reaching the terrace above, its self-grading yields nothing. Honest agents scattered across the meadow collect vouches from strangers and earn.
